methodology.latency: Sequential single-client perf_counter wall time; one warmup per operation, nearest-rank p95; not SLA
methodology.token_basis: Exact bytes; Unicode chars//4 estimates, no exact model tokenizer or billing claims
methodology.test_precision: Not measured against executed real-repo failures; candidate-file reduction only
methodology.isolation: Disposable native database plus uniquely owned graph copies; verified delete
methodology.task_selection: One deterministic highest-indexed-inbound function with current reparsed callers, excluding test directories; not representative of every task

repositories.task_selection: Highest indexed inbound CALLS with current reparsed callers; excludes test directories; qualified-name tie-break

call_index_drift.basis: Legacy indexed CALLS vs current conservative source reparse; not independent runtime accuracy

current_reparse_import_accuracy.oracle: stdlib AST, unambiguous absolute module paths only; not runtime ground truth

import_accuracy.oracle: stdlib AST, unambiguous absolute module paths only; not runtime ground truth

folding.basis: Exact UTF-8 captured-source vs exact wiki note; chars//4 is only an estimate; not equivalent content

impact.mutation: rename selected real function; leave downstream callers unchanged
impact.basis: Static candidate reduction by test FILE count, not tests safely skipped; no untrusted pytest executed
